guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice shows the largest anomalies in the digest (latency-90 +5011%, latency-50 +2420%, cpu +563% from 2.8 to 18.6, socket +535%, mem +58%), and every worst trace passes through it while the other services' metrics are flat. CPU saturation best explains the latency rise together with the growth in open sockets (requests queueing), but the socket and mem increases are also large, so the fault type is not fully certain and there are no logs or error spans to confirm it.

proposed_fix.description: Check recommendationservice CPU throttling and limits, then scale out replicas or raise its CPU limit and look for a hot code path or runaway workload. Restarting the pod is a fallback only if the CPU stays pegged.
